component: gas (GNU assembler from the same recovered tree)
lineage: game-compiler - Sony/Cygnus 2.9-ee-991111b (patched game default; SN parity target)
provenance: SN-distributed GNUPro/SCE source; Wayback ps2dev.sourceforge.net ee/gnu-ee-binutils-gcc-1.1.tar.gz (sha256 1f518043e252d6eda726386971d52eda26541ab936ea73a9783d73712b595f92)
role: R5900 assembler parity: the gp->absolute expansion of a relaxable load/store or la pair must produce the retail `lui base,0` + `op %lo(base)` form.
mechanism: md_convert_frag's expansion memcpy copies the pair and is entered twice for the same frag, so the first slot ends up holding a copy of the second instruction. After the copy, rebuild the first word as `lui base,0` with the base register taken from the second instruction's rs field (only the 4/8-byte, NO_PIC ld_st/la pairs). The rewrite is idempotent, and symbols that do get a .extern size keep the deferred gp relaxation.
fidelity_probes: `sw $2,D_X` with D_X undefined and no .extern -> gas now emits 0x3c010000 lui at,0 + 0xac220000 sw (was two sw words with HI16/LO16)
`.extern D_X,4` after the use -> still relaxes to a single gp-relative sw (deferred decision preserved)
`la $4,D_X` undefined -> lui a0,0 + addiu a0,a0,0 (was two addiu words)
